Every custom Christmas gift starts with your name, date or message. We set up the file, run the laser, clean up the piece and pack it in our veteran-owned shop in Piketon, Ohio. That takes real time, so order by Sunday, Dec 13 for Christmas delivery. Personalized ornaments and laser-engraved travel jewelry boxes are in our Etsy shop. Link in the pinned comment.
